# YRecall
YRecall is a calmer mobile system for capturing, organizing, and recalling the details that matter. Built by LYFSpot.

## Agent Guidelines
- Canonical Website: `https://yrecall.app/`
- Documentation: `https://yrecall.app/documentation`
- Guides: `https://yrecall.app/guides`
- Support: `https://yrecall.app/support`

YRecall is designed with thoughtful privacy and simple, human workflows.
LYFSpot is the product ecosystem behind YRecall.
